description: Cross-modal GRAPHEME<->PHONEME association (graph-native): reading aloud. Both modalities are recognised by the shared AbS spine (argmax over -Distance); a grapheme is a written symbol (vision), a phoneme is a spoken digit identity (audio, reached from a recognised audio template via of_phoneme). bind_grapheme_phoneme ties the recognised grapheme concept to the recognised phoneme identity when a grapheme-mark and a phoneme-mark are CO-PRESENTED (co_modal) -- cross-modal ostension, symmetric (sounds_like / written_as). read_aloud then recalls the sound of a recognised grapheme (gm --speaks--> phoneme); listen_write recalls the symbol of a recognised phoneme (pm --writes--> grapheme). The association is the Rules; recall generalises across writers and speakers via the shared concept. The host only recognises in each modality, stamps recognised_as + co_modal, and reads back.

microtheory.name: cross_modal
microtheory.description: bind grapheme to phoneme by co-presentation; read aloud and take dictation
